import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=0.4
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0]+params[1]*x+params[2]*x**3+params[3]*v+params[4]*v*np.abs(v)+params[5]*np.sin(v)
            +params[6]*C+params[7]*S+params[8]*v*C+params[9]*x*t
            +0.0*t*t)
